name: Credit Key Payment Gateway
author: egoodman

sections.description:
Flexible Ways for Your Buyers to Pay. Real Growth for You. Built for How Business Buys.
Your B2B buyers are managing rising costs, tighter margins, and cash flow gaps, and that caps what they spend with you. Credit Key raises the ceiling: flexible payment options from Net 30 up to 12 months, with credit decisions in seconds, even for growing businesses banks often decline, right in your WordPress checkout. One integration covers inventory purchases on Net Terms and bigger investments on monthly installments.

Why Integrate Credit Key?
✅ Credit Decisions in Seconds: buyers get a real-time decision on a line of credit up to $50,000, without leaving the purchase flow.
✅ Bigger Orders, More Sales: more spending power for your buyers means bigger orders for you, with stalled carts becoming orders.
✅ We Do the Heavy Lifting: Credit Key assumes the credit risk and handles underwriting, approvals, and collections. You’re paid in as little as 48 hours; the risk stays with us.
✅ Embedded Checkout Experience: buyers resolve payment at checkout without leaving your store.
✅ Simpler Receivables: faster payments, less manual invoicing, and easier reconciliation, with no terms program for your team to chase.

Credit Key is not a bank. Business-purpose loans made by Lead Bank, subject to credit approval.

Credit decisions in seconds, even for buyers traditional lenders skip
Banks want years in business, deep credit files, and proven revenue. Credit Key underwrites the growing businesses they pass on, delivering real-time decisions right in the purchase flow, subject to credit approval.

When buyers can pay over time, stalled carts become orders
Rising costs and cash flow gaps stall B2B purchases at payment, not at demand. Flexible options from Net 30, 60, 90 up to extended monthly terms remove the blocker, so buyers buy more, more often, in every channel you sell through: your WordPress checkout, in-store, or via sales reps.

You get paid in as little as 48 hours. The risk stays with us
Terms for your buyers no longer mean float for you. Credit Key assumes the credit risk and handles underwriting, approvals, and collections, so your team offers the option instead of running a terms program.

Credit lines up to $50K put serious purchasing power behind your carts
More spending power for your buyers means bigger orders for you. Reusable credit lines augment their cards and loans, raising the ceiling on average order value without adding exposure to your books.

Easy integration and fast implementation
Setup is simple: get approved as a Credit Key merchant, then embed Credit Key in your WordPress checkout.

Request a demo
sections.installation:
AUTOMATIC INSTALLATION:
1) Go to «Plugins > Add New»
2) In the search box type Credit Key Payment Gateway
3) From the search result you will see Credit Key Payment Gateway click on th button \”Install Now\” to install the plugin
4) A popup window will ask you to confirm your wish to install the Plugin.
5) After installation, activate the plugin.
6) Open the settings page for WooCommerce and click the «Payments» tab.
7) Click on the Credit Key link from the available Payments Options
8) Configure your Credit Key Payment Gateway settings.

MANUAL INSTALLATION:
1) Download the plugin zip file
2) Click on «Plugins > Add New» from the left hand menu.
3) Click on the «Upload» option, then click «Choose File» to select the zip file from your computer. Once selected, press «OK» and press the «Install Now» button.
4) Activate the plugin.
5) Open the settings page for WooCommerce and click the «Payments» tab.
6) Click on the Credit Key link from the available Payments Options
7) Configure your Credit Key Payment Gateway settings.
sections.changelog:
2.3.1

  • Hardening: the return/webhook endpoint now handles an unknown or invalid Credit Key id gracefully instead of a fatal error.
  • API calls to Credit Key now time out (10s connect, 30s total) instead of waiting indefinitely.
  • Fix: PHP warnings for missing cart alignment settings on stores that never re-saved the settings page.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2.

2.3

  • New setting: order status while the customer is in the Credit Key flow (defaults to Pending payment).
  • Fix: Payment method icon was missing in the WooCommerce Checkout block.
  • Fix: Staging and production API key fields now show and hide correctly before the gateway is enabled, and are labelled by environment.

2.2

  • SDK: Update bundled Credit Key PHP SDK to v1.0.7 (adds order_complete_url support to begin checkout).
  • Cart messaging: Add WooCommerce Cart block compatibility for on-site promotional messaging.
  • Fix: Register the payment gateway reliably regardless of plugin load order (previously the gateway could be dropped, leaving a blank settings page).
  • Fix: Selector-based cart messaging now uses the cart display method instead of the product one.

2.1

  • Ensure “Cancelled” orders cannot be reactivated or changed to “Completed”.
  • Allow manual status transition to “Cancelled” for confirmed orders.
  • SDK: Add logging helpers and confirm method logging.

2.0

  • HPOS support
  • Woo Blocks support
  • Hardcoded title fix
  • CSS tweaks

1.0.8.5

  • Sequential order numbers support

1.0.8.4

  • Changes in payment method settings

1.0.8.2

  • Remove wakeup and clone methods that throwed the warning

1.0.8.1

  • Fix for WooCommerce Sequential Order Numbers

1.0.8

  • Add support for WooCommerce Sequential Order Numbers by SkyVerge

1.0.7

  • Fix credit key icons showing at each gateway

1.0.6

  • Fix product title bug and minor styling issues

1.0.5

  • Fixes modal position for promotional messaging modal. Upgrade immediately.

1.0.1

  • This version fixes order totals bug. Upgrade immediately.
